releases.body: Moves the `opencode-beads` pairing note into the description so the server-side companion gets credit up front. No code changes.

First release.

Shows your current [beads](https://github.com/gastownhall/beads) plan and its progress in the opencode sidebar, following along as an agent works.

```
opencode plugin opencode-beads-sidebar --global
```

Requires `bd` on your PATH and opencode >= 1.18. Published with npm provenance.
